text:
sam: FYI — pushed a follow-up with all requested changes addressed. Rebased onto main, fixed the lint failures, and added a tiny unit test for the exponential backoff edge case. PTAL when you can; aiming for tomorrow's 10:00 PST canary slot.

sam: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123 — top of the PR has a short changelog of what I changed.

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — I can do a quick pass in ~30m and flag anything obvious.

alex: glanced through, left one optional nit around the logging formatter (nonblocking). otherwise looks good.

jenna: LGTM for canary if CI stays green. one ops ask: can we defer the schema/migration step to a follow-up so the canary only contains runtime fixes? avoids churn during rollout.

sam: good call — I removed the migration commit and moved it to a follow-up branch, left a TODO in the code. repro steps/local test command if helpful:
```
git fetch origin && git checkout -b tmp/rebase && git rebase origin/main
make test-unit```

maria: running tests locally now; will shout if anything flakes, otherwise :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — pinging for priority eyes because of the release window. if we have no blockers by 09:15 PST I'll merge and schedule the canary.

alex: Sounds good — will recheck the logging nit and either fix or mark as resolved.

jenna: I'll be on standby for canary monitoring.

sam: appreciated, everyone. will update the PR description with the follow-up branch for the migration.
